detail: T-79 application security and multi-tenant isolation audit. Closed the provider tracking webhook: no verified Mengantar push contract exists, the handler invented its headers, payload fields and status vocabulary, and it never worked because RLS denies the application role a tenant-less read. Forced RLS on memberships and tenants, revoked unused DELETE, and replaced table-wide UPDATE with column-scoped grants so a tenant move is refused at the privilege layer rather than only by a policy WITH CHECK. Consolidated four drifted maskPhone copies onto the stricter scheme and moved the RTS queue mask server-side. Stated the secure-cookie flag explicitly while keeping it origin-following outside production. Two independent security reviews were obtained; the second passed after proving the new posture guard binds by breaking it on a disposable database. Evidence: tsc, lint, build, 74 files and 565 integration tests, migration upgrade through 0036 on a clean database, a client-bundle scan of 57 chunks against the real credential value, and an authenticated browser pass over nine index views
